## Context

`docs/your-first-change.md` downloads the Gerrit hook directly, permits a small patch to bypass Gerrit, and recommends `recheck` when a failure appears flaky. Ticket fat-leaflike-canary introduced the tutorial. Tickets sultanlike-doughty-civet and sure-starred-springtail superseded its hook and retry instructions. Current project policy requires `make hooks`, Gerrit passage for every change to main, and root-cause work for nondeterministic tests.

## Plan

- Replace the direct hook download in `docs/your-first-change.md` with the supported `make hooks` command and revise the related setup guidance. Explain that `make hooks` installs and verifies the Gerrit `Change-Id` hook.
- State that every change to main passes through Gerrit. Describe maintainer sponsorship as assistance with the ticket and contribution without permitting a review bypass.
- Reserve `recheck` for demonstrated environmental faults. Direct nondeterministic test failures to root-cause remediation through the `/rebar-debug` workflow in `examples/agent-skills/rebar-debug/SKILL.md`.
- Add `tests/unit/test_your_first_change_guidance.py`. Positive assertions will require `make hooks`, Gerrit passage for every main change, sponsorship without a bypass, environmental-only `recheck` guidance, and the debugging workflow reference.
- Add negative assertions that reject the direct `curl` hook download, the phrase `skips Gerrit entirely`, instructions to use `recheck` when a failure only looks flaky, and the permissive `Likely a CI flake` guidance. These assertions ensure the new guidance cannot coexist with the superseded instructions.
- Run `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_your_first_change_guidance.py -q`, `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check`, `python scripts/check_dco_identity.py`, and `git diff --check`.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [x] The tutorial installs hooks only through `make hooks`, and direct hook download instructions are absent.
- [x] The tutorial states that every change to main passes through Gerrit.
- [x] Maintainer sponsorship is described without a Gerrit bypass, and the prior bypass language is absent.
- [x] `recheck` is reserved for demonstrated environmental faults, and suspected-flake retry instructions are absent.
- [x] Nondeterministic test failures link to the `/rebar-debug` workflow and require root-cause remediation.
- [x] `python -m pytest tests/unit/test_your_first_change_guidance.py -q` passes.
- [x] `python scripts/check_docs_index.py --check` passes.
